description: May 30 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 30 birthday falls in Gemini, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: The May 30 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Air, words and play converge on the 30th of May. The Sun sits eight degrees into Gemini, Mercury's own decan, and the birthday number 3 is traditionally the number of self-expression. Few dates are so strongly linked with conversation, humour and social ease. The growth point, as with many Geminis, is learning which half-finished ideas deserve a second draft.

Astronomically, May 30 puts the Sun near 8° Gemini in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Doubled Mercury makes the first ten degrees of Gemini, roughly May 21 to May 31, the most quicksilver part of an already lively sign. Curiosity is the engine here: questions, conversations, books opened at the middle, two projects running at once. Traditional descriptions stress wit, verbal agility and a talent for translating between people who would not otherwise understand each other. The same speed can make boredom arrive early and commitments feel like cages. For anyone born in this decan, depth often comes not from slowing down overall but from choosing one or two threads to follow all the way through.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for May 30
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a May 30 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous May 30 birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 30 is the 150th day of the year (151st in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Cancer, is usually complete within 23 days, by June 22.

By May 30 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a May 30 birthday are Mikhail Bakunin (1814), Idi Amin (1928) and Steven Gerrard (1980).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 30?
faq.answer: May 30 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 30 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 30?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 30, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 30?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on May 30 include Mikhail Bakunin (1814), Idi Amin (1928) and Steven Gerrard (1980). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
